hero.description: Go where the wildlife is. Travel with people who know the water, and return with a new way of seeing it.
hero.imageAlt: Whale shark moving through clear blue water
hero.asideText: Wild places cannot be scheduled. A considered journey gives you the best chance to meet them on their own terms.

intro.heading: The destination is only the beginning.
intro.body: We choose places for the wildlife you hope to meet, then shape an expedition around curiosity, experienced guidance and the freedom to be surprised.

story.heading: Fear gave way to fascination.
story.body: One small reef shark changed a young diver's perspective. More time in the water brought more questions, more respect and a simple ambition: help others meet wildlife with open eyes.

travel.body: Come with a group of like-minded travelers, ask us to build your own route, or make the expedition entirely private.

formats.title: Group expeditions
formats.body: Experienced guidance, shared discoveries and space to learn from the people beside you.

formats.title: Custom journeys
formats.body: Your interests lead. We shape the places, pace and additions around the trip you imagine.

formats.title: Exclusive travel
formats.body: A privately arranged experience with the people and level of support you choose.
